title: Scoped engineering relationship traversal
description: Project model supplies attributable traversal of a selected engineering state to command consumers, composing child-owned content, interpretation and traversal without publishing or mutating definitions.

operations.name: traverse_relationships
operations.purpose: Return complete, explicitly bounded or incomplete reachability for one admitted scope.
inputs: One project and selected-state reference, declared profile, nonempty starting identities, selected relationship types and outgoing, incoming or both direction.
Optional nonnegative maximum depth and entity-count bound no smaller than the unique start count; absence means no requested bound.
outputs: Exact admitted request and captured state/profile/membership identity; separate acquisition and exploration completeness.
Distinct reachable entities, finite supporting typed edges and witness paths with authored orientation and provenance.
Complete, bounded, incomplete or rejected outcome; explicit requested bounds, omitted/unfinished scope, diagnostics and reasons.
behavior: MOD-016 composes MOD-001 IF-001 state binding/content, MOD-003 IF-002 interpretation and MOD-004 FUNC-009/AR-056 traversal; child allocations and state authority remain unchanged.

Require the complete applicable relationship inventory, including incoming edges from entities outside the starting neighborhood. A caller-selected subset cannot silently become the whole selected model.

Apply the admission, deterministic breadth-first traversal, limit semantics and outcome contract in MOD-004 traversal.md. Current-state selection is bound to one coherent read state before exploration; do not switch to a retained Baseline or mix later reads.
Return derived read results only. Graph connectivity does not approve changes, determine impact, establish requirement satisfaction or confirm baseline retention.

failure_behavior.condition: A start is absent/ambiguous, type/direction/limit is unsupported or invalid, or selection spans projects/states/baselines.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject with the requested scope and actionable diagnostic; do not reinterpret the request.

failure_behavior.condition: Acquisition cannot establish coherent complete input, interpretation fails, a selected edge is unresolved, or traversal is interrupted/exhausts resources.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return incomplete with separately stated acquisition/exploration scope, known attributable observations and unresolved frontier; never report complete empty reachability.

consistency_rules: Every entity, edge and diagnostic binds the same selected state/profile. Reading current content requires an established consistent read, not before/after timestamps or a best-effort mutable scan.
Requested limits qualify the result even if fulfilled. Environmental resource limits or cancellation never become a requested bound or a complete result.
MOD-010 preserves all four outcomes, request and source attribution. It does not discard partial-result diagnostics or infer completion from a successful dispatch.
compatibility_rules: This logical read contract does not add a callable CLI command, wire version or entry to the current supported-capabilities catalogue. Admission and user syntax remain MOD-010-owned when realized.
IF-007 retains Baseline inspection meaning and IF-012 retains snapshot publication/recovery meaning. Neither is repurposed for traversal.
Unknown operations, types, directions and outcome values reject before dependent consistency or result processing; no fallback to outgoing or unrestricted scope.

sources.basis: Derive selected-state traversal responsibility, admission/completeness outcomes and necessary allocation from existing obligations. Proposed architecture only; no implementation, verification or satisfaction claim.
